frozen_predictions.legal_route: Use a genuinely excluded/conditionally exempt independent_contractor arrangement
frozen_predictions.statement: Where contractors are excluded, transitions from employee to legally excluded contractor status rise around commencement relative to comparable covered classes.

frozen_predictions.legal_route: Use a genuinely excluded/conditionally exempt per_diem arrangement
frozen_predictions.statement: Explicit seasonal or per-diem exclusions predict increased use of genuinely excluded classes relative to covered classes at commencement.

frozen_predictions.legal_route: Separate a worker before use entitlement
frozen_predictions.statement: Use waiting periods predict more separations in the final 14 days before entitlement than in the following 14 days, relative to laws without a use waiting period.
